name: Gets a list of system logs
description:
Lists system logs, search and filters allow fine grained lists to be generated.

     Query parameters can be added to performed more fine grained filtering of the system logs, these are handled by the SystemLogFilters class which defines the methods available
whenToUse: List and filter many system log records with pagination and sorting; reach for it to audit events or search logs broadly rather than fetch one by id.

queryParameters.name: include
queryParameters.description: Includes child relationships in the response, format is comma separated. Check each model for the list of associated includes

queryParameters.name: per_page
queryParameters.description: The number of records to return for each request, default is 20

queryParameters.name: page
queryParameters.description: The page number to return for this request (when performing pagination), default is 1

queryParameters.name: sort
queryParameters.description:
Order the list by choosing a column and direction. Each value uses the form `column|asc` or `column|desc`.

*Single sort** — for example `sort=created_at|desc`.

*Multiple sorts** — for example
`sort[]=id|desc&sort[]=created_at|desc`.

Log rows sort by columns exposed through `SystemLogFilters`. Unsupported keys are ignored.
